appointments_cancellation_check.name: appointments_cancellation_check
appointments_cancellation_check.value: ("appointments"."status" = 'cancelled') = ("appointments"."cancelled_at" is not null and "appointments"."cancelled_by" is not null)

patients_identity_check.name: patients_identity_check
patients_identity_check.value: "patients"."anonymized_at" is not null or ("patients"."phone" is not null and "patients"."name_normalized" is not null)

patients_anonymized_check.name: patients_anonymized_check
patients_anonymized_check.value: "patients"."anonymized_at" is null or ("patients"."phone" is null and "patients"."email" is null and "patients"."name_normalized" is null and "patients"."nickname" is null and "patients"."cpf" is null and "patients"."rg" is null and "patients"."landline_phone" is null and "patients"."birth_date" is null and "patients"."gender" is null and "patients"."referral_source" is null and "patients"."referred_by" is null and "patients"."notes" is null)

patients_lengths_check.name: patients_lengths_check
patients_lengths_check.value: char_length("patients"."nickname") <= 40 and char_length("patients"."rg") <= 20 and char_length("patients"."referred_by") <= 120 and char_length("patients"."notes") <= 1000
